opening.text: When you eat something wonderful, what do you do? You tell someone. You say, "You have to try this." You don't plan it. It just comes out. Missionary work works the same way. We found something good. We want others to taste it too.

mainMessage.text: Missionary work is sharing what is good with people we love. It starts with a happy heart, not a speech.

blocks.text: **The Lord asks us to share** The Savior sent His followers to every part of the world. He still asks us to share what we have received.
And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
Behold, I sent you out to testify and warn the people, and it becometh every man who hath been warned to warn his neighbor.
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “How Great Will Be Your Joy” from the October 2023 general conference.
It follows that to gather Israel we need missionaries—many more than are serving.
The invitation is open to all of us.
**The joy is the reward** A good meal is better when it is shared. The Lord says the same about souls.

And if it so be that you should labor all your days in crying repentance unto this people, and bring, save it be one soul unto me, how great shall be your joy with him in the kingdom of my Father! And now, if your joy will be great with one soul that you have brought unto me into the kingdom of my Father, how great will be your joy if you should bring many souls unto me!
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Right Before Our Eyes” from the April 2025 general conference.
More than numbers, the spirit of the gathering is bringing souls to Jesus Christ and His gospel.
The goal is a person, not a number.
**Let them smell the cooking** People are curious when something smells good. Our lives can do that. They show what the gospel does for us.

Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house. Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Safely Gathered Home” from the April 2023 general conference.
An essential part of this missionary effort is for individual members to become beacon-light examples wherever we live.
Live in a way that makes people ask.
**Say what you know** When someone asks, we can answer in plain words. We don't need to be experts. We only need to be honest.
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Right Before Our Eyes” from the April 2025 general conference.
We share our testimonies of Him, His Church, His ways, and His covenant path.
A simple testimony is enough.
**A seat at the table** A meal is not complete if the guest feels like a stranger. New members need friends who make room for them.
Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “The Lord Is Hastening His Work” from the October 2025 general conference.
We can be among the friends who assure these new converts that they belong and are not just guests.
Sharing ends with belonging.
**Say yes to the call** If you want to help, the Lord says you are already called to the work. You only need to rely on Him.

Therefore, if ye have desires to serve God ye are called to the work; rely upon the merits of Jesus Christ, and be glorified through faith in his name, and that through their repentance they might be saved. Amen. For behold the field is white already to harvest; and lo, he that thrusteth in his sickle with his might, the same layeth up in store that he perisheth not, but bringeth salvation to his soul;
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “How Great Will Be Your Joy” from the October 2023 general conference.
Mission fields around the world are pleading for your help.
If you have the desire, you are called.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time about sharing the gospel or being invited by someone. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: Philip and the man from Ethiopia

blocks.text: A man was reading the scriptures on the road. He did not understand them. Philip ran to him.

And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest? And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
Philip did not argue. He asked a question and then sat down beside him. Sharing starts by sitting beside someone.

application.text: First, think of one person you could invite to something simple. Second, pray for the courage to ask. Third, ask this week, and then let them choose.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know the gospel brings real joy. I want others to feel what I have felt. I know God loves every one of His children. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

mainMessage.text: We build bridges with kindness, honesty and our own faith. The Lord does the rest.

blocks.text: **The Lord drew the plans** The bridge was His idea. He told His followers to carry the gospel everywhere.
And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

It follows that to gather Israel we need missionaries—many more than are serving.
He asks for builders.

Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Safely Gathered Home” from the April 2023 general conference.
An essential part of this missionary effort is for individual members to become beacon-light examples wherever we live.
A good life is a sturdy bridge.
**The first plank** Every bridge starts with one plank. Often that plank is a simple answer to a sincere question.
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Right Before Our Eyes” from the April 2025 general conference.
We share our testimonies of Him, His Church, His ways, and His covenant path.
Testimony lays the first plank.
**Stay on the bridge** Some people cross and then feel alone on the other side. Friends who stay with them help them feel at home.
Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “The Lord Is Hastening His Work” from the October 2025 general conference.
We can be among the friends who assure these new converts that they belong and are not just guests.
Don't leave a new friend halfway across.
**Pick up a tool** You don't need a title to help build. The Lord says a desire to serve is enough.

Therefore, if ye have desires to serve God ye are called to the work; rely upon the merits of Jesus Christ, and be glorified through faith in his name, and that through their repentance they might be saved. Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “How Great Will Be Your Joy” from the October 2023 general conference.

The work needs more hands.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time about a friend who helped them find the gospel, or a time they helped someone else. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: Come and see

blocks.text: Philip found Nathanael and told him about Jesus. Nathanael doubted.

Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph. And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
Philip did not win the debate. He said, "Come and see." That is still the best invitation we have.

application.text: First, think of someone who seems far from the gospel. Second, pick one kind thing to do for them this week. Third, when the moment is right, say, "Come and see."

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know Jesus Christ is the bridge between us and God. I am grateful for those who helped me cross. I want to help someone else. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

We share our testimonies of Him, His Church, His ways, and His covenant path.

**Keep the light on** A new member can feel like a guest. Friends who keep the light on make the house feel like home.

Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “How Great Will Be Your Joy” from the October 2023 general conference.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time about a person whose life made them curious about the gospel. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: The woman at the well

blocks.text: A woman met Jesus at a well. She left her waterpot and ran back to town.
The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men, Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
She did not wait until she knew everything. She shared what she had just felt. That was enough to bring a town out to meet Him.

application.text: First, think about what people see in your life. Second, pick one habit that shows your faith, like kindness or honesty. Third, practice it this week, and see who notices.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know Jesus Christ is the light of the world. I want my life to point to Him. I know He loves every person who walks in the dark. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

mainMessage.text: We have a map that worked for us. Missionary work is handing it to someone who is looking.

blocks.text: **The map came from Him** The Savior drew the way. Then He asked His followers to hand it on.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time about someone who handed them the gospel when they needed it. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: Andrew brings his brother

blocks.text: Andrew met Jesus. The first thing he did was go and find his brother.

One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother. He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ. And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
Andrew started with family. His brother Simon became Peter. One invitation led to a great apostle.

application.text: First, think of a family member or friend who might be looking for direction. Second, tell them one thing the gospel has done for you. Third, invite them to take one small step.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I am grateful for the map I was given. I know it leads home. I know Jesus Christ is the way. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

versions.analogy: A map for a lost traveler

mainMessage.text: We don't force anyone up. We steady the ladder with love, example and a simple testimony.

blocks.text: **The ladder was set by Him** The Lord set the ladder in place. Then He asked us to stand beside it and help.
And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
Behold, I sent you out to testify and warn the people, and it becometh every man who hath been warned to warn his neighbor.
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “How Great Will Be Your Joy” from the October 2023 general conference.
It follows that to gather Israel we need missionaries—many more than are serving.
Many ladders need steady hands.
**The view from the top** When a person reaches the top, the joy is shared by everyone who helped. The Lord says that joy is great.

And if it so be that you should labor all your days in crying repentance unto this people, and bring, save it be one soul unto me, how great shall be your joy with him in the kingdom of my Father! Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Right Before Our Eyes” from the April 2025 general conference.
More than numbers, the spirit of the gathering is bringing souls to Jesus Christ and His gospel.
The joy is in the person.
**A steady stance** A ladder holder has to stand firm. People lean on those who look steady. Our lives show what the gospel does.

Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. Stand firm so others feel safe.
**Call up what you can see** A ladder holder talks to the climber. Say what you see from where you stand. Say what you know.
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Right Before Our Eyes” from the April 2025 general conference.
We share our testimonies of Him, His Church, His ways, and His covenant path.
A calm voice helps a climber.
**Be there on the landing** When someone reaches the top, they need a friend waiting. New members need people who say, "You belong here."

story.prompt: The member tells a true time about preparing to share the gospel, or about someone who prepared before helping them. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: The sons of Mosiah prepare

blocks.text: The sons of Mosiah went to teach people who did not know the gospel. Before they went, they got ready.

Now these sons of Mosiah were with Alma at the time the angel first appeared unto him; therefore Alma did rejoice exceedingly to see his brethren; and what added more to his joy, they were still his brethren in the Lord; yea, and they had waxed strong in the knowledge of the truth; for they were men of a sound understanding and they had searched the scriptures diligently, that they might know the word of God. But this is not all; they had given themselves to much prayer, and fasting; therefore they had the spirit of prophecy, and the spirit of revelation, and when they taught, they taught with power and authority of God.
They read, prayed and fasted. Their strength came from preparing. We can prepare too.

application.text: First, read one chapter of scripture this week with a friend in mind. Second, pray for that friend by name. Third, ask how you can help them with something they care about.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know the Lord holds the ladder from above. I know He wants every person to reach Him. I am willing to help. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.
